title: 第16章 世间再无冠军侯
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
唯一的“动”的，就是那片，从地宫门缝中，涌出的，白光。

    它无声无息，却又势不可挡。

    它没有温度，却又能焚尽万物。

    它没有实体，却又能湮灭一切。

    第一个，被白光触及的，是距离最近的，那十几名，还保持着撞门姿势的绣衣使者。

    他们脸上的表情，还凝固在，看到石门裂开的，那喜悦和错愕上。

    然后，在白光的笼罩下。

    他们的身体，他们的铠甲，他们的兵器，没有燃烧，没有爆炸，没有化为飞灰。

    而是，就那么，悄无声息地，“消失”了。

    他们从来，就没有存在过这个世界上。

    被从这幅画卷上，彻底地，抹去。

    紧接着，是霍去病。

    这位大汉王朝，最年轻，最骄傲，最不可一世的冠军侯。

    他眼中的惊恐，甚至都来不及，完全绽放。

    白光，便已经，吞噬了他。

    他和他胯下那匹，曾随他征战漠北的宝马，一同，化为了虚无。

    没有留下一毫的痕迹。

    白光，没有停下。

    它如同决堤的洪水，以地宫入口为中心，朝着四面八方，疯狂地扩散。

    两百名精锐的绣衣使者，在不到一个呼吸的时间里，尽数湮灭。

    瘫倒在地的国相，在被白光吞噬的前一刻，他那浑浊的眼中，没有恐惧，反而，露出了，解脱笑容。

    “大王……您，终究还是，成了仙啊……”

    这是他留在这个世界上，最后的念头。

    白光，越过了卧龙山。

    山上的树木，岩石，飞鸟，走兽，在白光的席卷下，无声地消失。

    整座卧龙山，就被一只无形的大手，从大地上，生生抹平。

    白光，继续扩散。

    它涌向了，不远处的，寿春城。

    那座高大巍峨的城墙，在那片白光面前，脆弱得，如同一张薄纸。

    瞬间，便被撕裂，吞噬。

    城内，数十万，正在为生计奔波，为家长里短而烦恼，为淮南王的逝去而悲伤的百姓。

    他们甚至，都不知道，发生了什么。

    或许，有人，在生命的最后一刻，看到了窗外，那片，淹没了一切的，纯白。

    然后，便再也没有然后了。

    淮南王府。

    那些被软禁在院子里的，刘安的妻妾，子嗣，门客。

    那些，看守着他们的，一百名绣衣使者。

    也都在这片，公平的，不分贵贱的白光之中，一同，走向了终结。

    白光的速度，快到了极致。
content_en:
The only thing that "moved" was the piece of white light pouring out from the crack in the underground palace door.

    It is silent, yet unstoppable.

    It has no temperature, but it can burn everything.

    It has no entity, but it can annihilate everything.

    The first one touched by the white light was the nearest one, the dozen or so embroidered messengers who were still in the posture of slamming into the door.

    The expressions on their faces were still frozen in the joy and shock of seeing the stone door crack.

    Then, shrouded in white light.

    Their bodies, their armor, and their weapons did not burn, explode, or turn into ashes.

    Instead, it just "disappeared" quietly.

    They have never existed in this world.

    It was completely erased from this picture.

    Immediately afterwards, it was Huo Qubing.

    This Han Dynasty is the youngest, most proud, and most arrogant champion.

    The panic in his eyes didn't even have time to fully bloom.

    The white light had already swallowed him up.

    He and the horse under his crotch, which had accompanied him on the expedition to Mobei, turned into nothingness.

    Not a single trace was left.

    The white light didn't stop.

    It was like a flood that broke a bank, centered at the entrance to the underground palace, spreading crazily in all directions.

    Two hundred elite embroidered messengers were all annihilated in less than a breath.

    The moment before the Prime Minister collapsed on the ground was swallowed up by the white light, there was no fear in his cloudy eyes. Instead, he showed a smile of relief.

    "Your Majesty... you have become an immortal after all..."

    This was his last thought in this world.

    The white light crossed Wolong Mountain.

    The trees, rocks, birds, and animals on the mountain disappeared silently under the sweep of white light.

    The entire Wolong Mountain was wiped away from the ground by an invisible hand.

    The white light continues to spread.

    It rushed towards Shouchun City, not far away.

    That tall and majestic city wall was as fragile as a thin piece of paper in front of that white light.

    In an instant, it was torn apart and swallowed.

    In the city, there are hundreds of thousands of people who are running for a living, troubled by the family's shortcomings, and saddened by the death of King Huainan.

    They didn't even know what happened.

    Perhaps, at the last moment of his life, someone saw the pure white outside the window, drowning everything.

    Then, there was no more.

    Huainan Prince's Mansion.

    Those who were under house arrest in the courtyard were Liu An's wives, concubines, children, and retainers.

    Those guarding them were a hundred embroidered messengers.

    They all came to an end together in this piece of fair, white light that did not distinguish between high and low.

    The speed of the white light was extremely fast.
title_en: Chapter 16 There is no more champion in the world
